info.name: Grok.com — SpaceX Mission Control Theme
info.description: Transform Grok.com into a sleek SpaceX Mission Control interface. Features a stunning SpaceX rocket launch night sky background, deep space dark color palette, cyan/blue accent colors inspired by SpaceX HUD displays, glowing input fields, frosted glass sidebar, and a futuristic monospace-influenced aesthetic. Built for space enthusiasts who AI.
info.additionalInfo: v1.0 — Initial release. Applies SpaceX Mission Control dark theme to all major UI elements: body background uses SpaceX Iridium-4 night launch photo (public domain, CC0) with a 72% opacity dark overlay to ensure text readability. Cyan/blue HUD color palette throughout. Frosted glass sidebar and input panels. Glowing focus states on inputs. Custom scrollbars.
